text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After agonizing over her final race, Fine 
Motion left the choice to her Trainer. 
Which of these four would be her final 
goal—?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First is the historic grand stage: the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn). Zenno Rob Roy, who 
once likened Fine Motion to the 
"protagonist of a story," is set to 
compete.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The second is the Queen Elizabeth II Cup. 
A proud race steeped in memories, where a 
rematch with the "Empress," Air Groove, 
will finally come true...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The third race, the Mile Championship, 
looks exciting too. Kawakami Princess, who 
had a heated "Princess? Showdown," is set 
to run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her friend Daiwa Scarlet, and... Air 
Shakur are running in the Arima Kinen! The 
race she chose as her final target was—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Target race changed to Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, their final goal was set. Steeling 
their resolve, the two head towards the 
race...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:

Cup.
